CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_academy_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ select exists(select 1 from public.academy_admins where user_id=(select auth.uid())); $function$

functions.name: archive_academy_course
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.archive_academy_course(course_id text, archive boolean)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if not public.is_academy_admin() then raise exception 'Administrator access required' using errcode='42501'; end if;
 update public.academy_courses set archived=coalesce(archive,true),updated_at=now() where id=course_id;
 if not found then raise exception 'Course not found'; end if;
end; $function$

functions.name: course_is_available
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.course_is_available(course_key text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce(
  (select published and not archived from public.academy_courses where id=course_key),
  course_key in ('heart-foundations','ecg-essentials','prevention')
 );
$function$
